data.name: Thomas
data.gender_notes: Thomas is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Aramaic te'oma, 'twin', via the Greek Thomas. Its root is Aramaic t-ʾ-m. Thomas the Apostle, called 'the Twin'. Thomas is a Aramaic name meaning “Twin”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thomas expresses “Twin”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Aramaic te'oma, 'twin', via the Greek Thomas.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thomas total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
